# pytest JUnit XML

`junit.xml` was captured, unedited, from a real run of
`python -m pytest --junitxml=junit.xml -q -p no:cacheprovider` on
`test_demo.py.txt` (saved as `tests/test_demo.py` in a fresh directory
with an empty `pytest.ini`, so the class names start at `tests`).

- Tool: pytest 9.1.1, Python 3.12.12
- OS: Darwin arm64 (macOS)
- Date: 2026-10-19
- Used by: `tests/project/test_project_detect.py`
